visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with black glasses and a black face mask sits on the left holding an orange cat with a yellow collar; a woman with long dark hair sits on the right smiling and pointing toward the camera. They are in a warmly lit indoor room with light wood walls. (2) The woman holds up a dark rectangular box with red graphics and character silhouettes, pointing to the figurines shown on the back. (3) A series of rapid cuts show the man and woman tearing open individual small blind boxes from the main set. (4) Close-up shot of a small figurine named Kakuzu, featuring grey hair and a mask, set against a spinning blue background effect. (5) Close-up shot of a figurine named Pain with orange hair and facial piercings, standing on a white star-shaped base. (6) Close-up shot of an Itachi figurine with long black hair and a red-patterned cloak, gesturing with one hand. (7) Close-up shot of a Kisame figurine with blue skin, holding a shark-skin sword and standing on a blue water-splash base. (8) Close-up shot of a Deidara figurine with blonde hair in a ponytail, holding a white clay bird with fire effects at the base. (9) Close-up shot of a Konan figurine with purple hair and a blue flower, featuring white paper wings. (10) Close-up shot of a Zetsu figurine with a half-black, half-white face surrounded by green leaf-like structures. (11) Close-up shot of a Hidan figurine with grey hair holding a large red three-bladed scythe. (12) Close-up shot of a Tobi figurine with an orange mask holding a small white bomb. (13) The man and woman return to the screen with all the assembled figurines lined up in front of them, smiling and making peace signs.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with an energetic greeting from a female voice, accompanied by high-tempo, upbeat electronic background music and a quick 'whoosh' sound effect as graphics appear. (2) A male voice joins in, speaking with high arousal; their conversation is punctuated by several 'impact' and 'pop' SFX that align with the jump cuts in visual unboxing. (3) As each figurine is revealed, the female voice exclaims names with rising intonation, followed by a bright 'ding' or 'sparkle' SFX that emphasizes the product detail. (4) The middle section features rapid-fire banter between the two speakers with constant background music, maintaining a fast pace without significant pauses. (5) In the final phase, the voices become warmer and more personal as they discuss favorites and birthday wishes, ending with a final 'whoosh' stinger SFX as the music fades.
